desc.zh: 把完成的括号组压成一个真假值，逐步推导栈解析。
desc.en: Derive stack parsing by reducing each completed group to one truth value.

concepts.name: Boolean group reduction
concepts.description: Replace innermost completed groups by truth literals while preserving unresolved outer context.

concepts.name: Iterative Boolean parser
concepts.description: Use stack snapshots and operator-specific truth flags to parse each character once.
